description:
fromProgram is derived live by joining program_exercise, so removing an exercise from a day rewrites what history claims was planned that day. Snapshot it onto set_log at insert, along with the exercise kind that decides how the row's other columns are read.

RULES 1: every historical row snapshots the facts that mattered at write time. This is also the precondition RULES 4 names before exercise.kind could ever become editable, so it gates any future rename-plus-retype work.
title: Snapshot program context onto set_log at write time
